User story: US-1: As a student I want to view all upcoming study sessions
Rule: Must list all 3 seed sessions with available places

User story: US-2: As a student I want to view details of a specific session
Rule: Returns session metadata and confirmed aliases

User story: US-3: As a student I want to book a place using a fictional alias
Rule: Must not exceed capacity; cannot duplicate active booking

User story: US-4: As a system I must reject bookings when capacity is exhausted
Rule: The 4th booking on a 3-place session must be rejected

User story: US-5: As a student I want to cancel my booking and free my place
Rule: Cancelling releases seat immediately back to pool

User story: US-6: As an operator data must survive server restarts
Rule: Bookings must remain intact after restart
Smallest proof: File persistence verified via SQLite query
